title: An Intuitive Introduction to Machine Learning · Why read this book?
description: Familiar metaphors become precise numerical mechanisms, while evaluation and human choices determine what those mechanisms are worth.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: What does a model actually learn from its examples, scores and rewards, and when should we trust it?
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Familiar metaphors become precise numerical mechanisms, while evaluation and human choices determine what those mechanisms are worth.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: Curious readers and technical beginners who want intuition grounded in mechanisms and honest evaluation.
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Start with the apprentice, then keep the sealed test beside each new model.
